name: Cancore
description: Self-custody Canton wallet in the browser: keys stay on the user's device, the server prepares and submits but never signs. CIP-0103 remote profile over JSON-RPC + SSE, with a consent screen per dApp origin. Today it signs messages and reports transaction status for Cancore's own operations; it does not execute a dApp's own Daml command and does not proxy the Ledger API.
